messages:
morgan: Need a quick break-glass SSH proxy for customer-xyz VPC to pull redaction logs for a privacy request. Will only copy `redact-audit-logs.tar.gz` to our secure s3 bucket and exit. ticket INC-4123 linked. Requesting 30m window starting ASAP. @security @oncall

selena: Can you confirm exact hosts and commands? Also scope (read-only) and reason high level for audit record?

morgan: Hosts: bastion-03 -> jump-prod-logs (10.3.21.45). Command: `scp /var/log/redact-audit-logs.tar.gz s3://redwood-privacy/INC-4123/` then `rm` locally. Read-only on target. Reason: privacy team verified sample contains PII, need original log segments to validate redaction.

kevin: @morgan thanks. Two quick policy items: 1) use ephemeral role only (no long-lived keys) 2) enable session recording. Can you confirm you'll use the provided ephemeral SSH proxy and not direct key?

morgan: yep using ephemeral session generated by oncall flow, no private keys. session will be limited to my user.

security-bot: Policy check: break-glass allowed for verified privacy incidents when ticket present. Required approvers: oncall + sec_eng. Automated audit note appended to INC-4123.

oncall: Quick OK from me for 30m. Provisioning ephemeral proxy now — session id sess-2026-07-19-88. Proxy URL: https://ssh.redwood.internal/sess/sess-2026-07-19-88 (expires in 30m).

kevin: I approve as sec_eng. Please attach justification to INC-4123: "PII verification for redaction QA; minimal scope; copy to secure bucket; session recorded."

rachel: I'll monitor logs and watch for any sensitive export. Ping me when transfer starts.

morgan: Starting transfer in ~1m via proxy. Will paste SCP output here when done.

morgan: scp complete, checksum matches, uploaded to s3://redwood-privacy/INC-4123/redact-audit-logs.tar.gz. Command used: `scp /var/log/redact-audit-logs.tar.gz s3://redwood-privacy/INC-4123/`

rachel: saw the S3 put S3 event, good.

kevin: Thanks — closing elevated window. Please confirm you deleted any local copies on the jumped host.

morgan: confirmed `rm /var/log/redact-audit-logs.tar.gz` done. session ending now. Thanks all :thumbsup:

oncall: Session sess-2026-07-19-88 terminated and archived to audit. INC-4123 updated with approvers and session id.

morgan: appreciate it, closing thread."
